findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 2 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 148 questions numbered 1-148; by section: 2.1 9, 2.2 17, 2.3 21, 2.4 21, 2.5 18, 2.6 18, 2.7 7, 2.8 16, 2.9 13, 2.10 8. Keys: {'a': 37, 'b': 37, 'c': 37, 'd': 37}.

Covers every section in book order: programming basics and the development environment, syntax, comments, variables, naming rules, data types, input/output, all operator groups, expressions and precedence, every decision and loop form with range(), functions (parameters, defaults, keyword and arbitrary arguments), libraries and the module search path, lists, tuples, indexing and slicing, modules and the main function, CLI applications, classes, constructor and destructor, access modifiers, association, inheritance, polymorphism, exceptions, files and file modes, testing and debugging. None repeats the chapter exercise. Every program in a question was run in Python 3 and its real output is the key. Book corrections followed (BMI = weight / height ** 2, the missing comma in a list joins two strings, remove() of an absent item is a ValueError, names cannot contain hyphens).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
